title: Ragefire Chasm
content: Ragefire Chasm is a level 13-18 dungeon located beneath Orgrimmar. This fiery cavern is inhabited by troggs and dark shaman cultists. Key bosses include Taragaman the Hungerer and Bazzalan. Players can find mail armor, weapons, and various items. This dungeon teaches basic group coordination and is often the first instance new players experience. It's accessible through a cave entrance in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

title: The Deadmines
content: The Deadmines is a level 15-21 dungeon located in the hills of Westfall. This extensive mine system is controlled by the Defias Brotherhood led by Edwin VanCleef. Key bosses include Rhahk'Zor, Sneed's Shredder, and Edwin VanCleef himself. Players navigate complex mine cart tracks and fight various Defias members. This dungeon offers good loot for its level range and teaches players about pirate themes and organized crime in Azeroth.

title: Wailing Caverns
content: Wailing Caverns is a level 15-25 dungeon located in the Barrens. This vast underground cave system has been corrupted by the druid Naralex and his followers. Key bosses include Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, and Mutanus the Devourer. Players fight various serpent creatures and corrupted wildlife. This dungeon features a unique emerald dream corruption theme and offers good experience and loot for mid-level players.

title: Shadowfang Keep
content: Shadowfang Keep is a level 18-25 dungeon located in Silverpine Forest. This haunted castle is controlled by the worgen and led by Lord Godfrey. Key bosses include Rethilgore, Baron Ashbury, and Lord Walden. Players navigate through castle halls fighting undead and worgen enemies. This dungeon offers good loot and experience, with a horror theme involving werewolves and haunted nobility.

title: Blackfathom Deeps
content: Blackfathom Deeps is a level 20-27 dungeon located beneath the pool of Aszhara in Ashenvale. This underwater temple is controlled by the Twilight's Hammer cult and naga. Key bosses include Ghamoo-ra, Lady Sarevess, and Aku'mai. Players fight through watery chambers and encounter various aquatic enemies. This dungeon has a strong aquatic and cult theme with good loot for its level range.

title: Lower Blackrock Spire
content: Lower Blackrock Spire is a level 55-60 dungeon located in the Burning Steppes. This lower section of Blackrock Spire is controlled by various dark creatures and warlords. Key bosses include Highlord Omokk, Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin, and War Master Voone. Players fight through orc and dragonkin enemies in a volcanic fortress. This high-level dungeon offers excellent loot and is part of the Blackrock Mountain complex.

title: Scholomance
content: Scholomance is a level 55-60 dungeon located in the Western Plaguelands. This haunted school of necromancy is controlled by the Scourge and dark mages. Key bosses include Kirtonos the Herald, Jandice Barov, and Darkmaster Gandling. Players fight through classrooms and libraries battling undead scholars and experiments. This dungeon has a strong academic horror theme with excellent loot for its level.

title: Stratholme
content: Stratholme is a level 55-60 dungeon located in the Eastern Plaguelands. This cursed city is divided into two wings: Scarlet Stratholme and Undead Stratholme. Key bosses include Balnazzar, Baron Rivendare, and various undead lords. Players navigate through a ruined city fighting Scourge and Scarlet Crusade forces. This large dungeon offers excellent loot and has a strong plague and undead theme.

title: Onyxia's Lair
content: Onyxia's Lair is a level 80 revamp raid in Dustwallow Marsh. Onyxia returns with updated mechanics including deep breath, adds, and phase transitions. Drops tier 9-style loot and the Onyxian Drake mount. A nostalgic one-boss raid for pugs.

title: Molten Core
content: Molten Core is a level 60 raid dungeon located beneath Blackrock Mountain. This fiery cavern is home to Ragnaros and his elemental lieutenants. Key bosses include Lucifron, Magmadar, Gehennas, and Ragnaros himself. Players fight through waves of fire elementals and major bosses. This raid offers legendary items and is the premier endgame content of Classic WoW.

title: Blackwing Lair
content: Blackwing Lair is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Blackrock Spire. This draconic fortress is home to Nefarian and his black dragonflight. Key bosses include Razorgore, Vaelastrasz, and Nefarian himself. Players navigate through dragon-themed chambers fighting drakes and lieutenants. This raid offers excellent loot and is known for its complex encounters requiring precise coordination.

title: Naxxramas
content: Naxxramas is a level 80 raid floating above Dragonblight in Wrath (previously level 60 in Classic). Kel'Thuzad leads the Scourge from this necropolis. Four quarters: Arachnid, Plague, Military, and Construct. Entry-level Wrath raid alongside Obsidian Sanctum, dropping tier 7 gear in 10 and 25-player modes.

title: Ulduar
content: Ulduar is a level 80 raid dungeon located in the Storm Peaks of Northrend. This titanic complex is home to Yogg-Saron and various titan constructs. The raid features multiple wings including the Siege of Ulduar, Antechamber, and Inner Sanctum. Key bosses include Flame Leviathan, XT-002 Deconstructor, and Yogg-Saron. This raid offers excellent loot and features complex mechanical encounters.

title: Blackrock Depths
content: Blackrock Depths is a level 52-60 dungeon located in Blackrock Mountain. This massive prison complex is home to the Dark Iron dwarves and various prisoners. Key bosses include Lord Incendius, Bael'Gar, and Emperor Dagran Thaurissan. Players navigate through forges, arenas, and cells fighting dwarves and elementals. This dungeon offers excellent loot and has a strong prison theme.

title: Dire Maul
content: Dire Maul is a level 55-60 dungeon complex located in Feralas. This ancient night elf ruin is divided into three wings: Warpwood Quarter, Capital Gardens, and Gordok Commons. Key bosses include Pusillin, Lethtendris, and King Gordok. Players fight through corrupted wildlife and ogres. This dungeon offers good loot and has a strong nature corruption theme.

title: Maraudon
content: Maraudon is a level 45-55 dungeon located in the Valley of Spears in Desolace. This ancient centaur burial ground is corrupted by the evil Princess Theradras. Key bosses include Noxxion, Razorlash, and Princess Theradras herself. Players fight through caverns filled with centaurs and earthen elementals. This dungeon offers good loot and has a strong earth and corruption theme.

title: Sunken Temple
content: Sunken Temple is a level 50-60 dungeon located in the Swamp of Sorrows. This ancient troll temple is controlled by the Atal'ai and corrupted by Hakkar the Soulflayer. Key bosses include Jammal'an the Prophet, Shade of Eranikus, and Avatar of Hakkar. Players fight through temple chambers battling trolls and dragons. This dungeon offers excellent loot and has a strong troll and corruption theme.

title: Zul'Farrak
content: Zul'Farrak is a level 44-54 dungeon located in Tanaris. This ancient troll city is controlled by the Sandfury trolls and Chief Ukorz Sandscalp. Key bosses include Antu'sul, Theka the Martyr, and Chief Ukorz. Players fight through sandy ruins battling trolls and hydras. This dungeon offers good loot and has a strong desert and troll theme.

title: Zul'Gurub
content: Zul'Gurub is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Stranglethorn Vale. This ancient troll empire stronghold is controlled by the Gurubashi trolls and Hakkar the Soulflayer. Key bosses include High Priestess Jeklik, Bloodlord Mandokir, and Hakkar himself. Players fight through jungle ruins battling trolls and wildlife. This raid offers excellent loot and has a strong troll and jungle theme.

title: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj
content: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Silithus. This ancient qiraji fortress is controlled by the silithid and their leaders. Key bosses include Kurinnaxx, General Rajaxx, and Ossirian the Unscarred. Players fight through sandy ruins battling insectoid enemies. This raid offers excellent loot and is part of the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort.

title: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
content: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Silithus. This massive qiraji temple is home to C'Thun and his lieutenants. Key bosses include The Prophet Skeram, Princess Huhuran, and C'Thun himself. Players fight through temple chambers battling insectoid horrors. This raid offers the best loot in Classic WoW and features extremely complex encounters.

title: Utgarde Keep
content: Utgarde Keep is a level 70-72 dungeon in Howling Fjord, the first Northrend instance most players run. Vrykul warriors led by Prince Keleseth and Ingvar the Plunderer defend the keep. Normal mode suits leveling; heroic requires level 80 and ilvl 180. The dungeon introduces Scourge-vrykul conflict and Northrend dungeon mechanics.

title: Utgarde Pinnacle
content: Utgarde Pinnacle is a level 80 dungeon atop Utgarde Keep in Howling Fjord. Players fight vrykul including Skadi the Ruthless and King Ymiron. Heroic mode drops emblem gear. The dungeon has a gauntlet event and is among the harder Wrath heroics.

title: The Nexus
content: The Nexus is a level 71-73 dungeon in Borean Tundra inside the blue dragonflight's stronghold. Commander Kolurg/Stoutbeard, Grand Magus Telestra, and Keristrasza are key bosses. The dungeon ties into Malygos and the Nexus War storyline. The Eye of Eternity raid is in the same structure.

title: The Oculus
content: The Oculus is a level 80 dungeon in Borean Tundra where players ride drakes to fight Varos Cloudstrider, Mage-Lord Urom, and Ley-Guardian Eregos. The dragon vehicle mechanics make it memorable. Heroic drops include the Reins of the Blue Drake mount.

title: Azjol-Nerub
content: Azjol-Nerub is a level 72-74 dungeon in Dragonblight featuring the nerubian spider-people. Bosses include Krik'thir the Gatewatcher, Hadronox, and Anub'arak. The dungeon explores the fallen nerubian empire and their war with the Scourge.

title: Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom
content: Ahn'kahet is a level 73-75 dungeon beneath Dragonblight, a twisted nerubian temple corrupted by faceless ones and the Old Gods. Elder Nadox, Jedoga Shadowseeker, and Herald Volazj are bosses. The Twilight Hammer cult appears here.

title: Drak'Tharon Keep
content: Drak'Tharon Keep is a level 74-76 dungeon in Zul'Drak held by the Scourge and Drakkari trolls. Trollgore, Novos the Summoner, and King Dred are bosses. The keep overlooks Gundrak and ties into Drakkari loa sacrifice storylines.

title: Gundrak
content: Gundrak is a level 76-78 dungeon in northeastern Zul'Drak, capital of the Drakkari ice trolls. Slad'ran, Moorabi, and Gal'darah defend the temple. The trolls sacrificed their loa to empower themselves against the Scourge. Heroic Gundrak drops strong pre-raid gear.

title: The Violet Hold
content: The Violet Hold is a level 75-77 dungeon in Dalaran, a prison breached by the Blue Dragonflight. Players defend against waves of random prisoners culminating in Cyanigosa or Erekem variants. It is a quick daily heroic for emblem farming.

title: Halls of Stone
content: Halls of Stone is a level 77-79 dungeon in Storm Peaks within Ulduar's outer halls. Tribunal of Ages, Krystallus, and Sjonnir the Ironshaper are bosses. The Brann Bronzebeard escort event explains titan history. Connects to Ulduar raid lore.

title: Halls of Lightning
content: Halls of Lightning is a level 80 dungeon in Storm Peaks, prison of the corrupted titan watcher Loken. General Bjarngrim, Volkhan, and Loken himself are bosses. The dungeon reveals Loken's betrayal and connection to Yogg-Saron.

title: The Culling of Stratholme
content: The Culling of Stratholme is a level 80 Caverns of Time dungeon where players help Arthas purge Stratholme of the plague. Infinite Dragonflight interference and the Mal'Ganis encounter recreate iconic Warcraft III events. Heroic drops include the Bronze Drake mount.

title: Trial of the Champion
content: Trial of the Champion is a level 80 dungeon at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Players fight faction champions and the Black Knight in arena-style encounters. It drops emblem gear and is a quick daily during the tournament event.

title: The Forge of Souls
content: The Forge of Souls is the first of three Icecrown Citadel 5-man wings (FoS/PoS/HoR). Players enter the citadel's soul-grinding forge and fight Bronjahm and the Devourer of Souls. This chain leads toward the Lich King's inner sanctum.

title: Pit of Saron
content: Pit of Saron is the second ICC 5-man wing. Alliance and Horde forces assault the pit where slaves mine saronite. Bosses include Garfrost, Ick, and Tyrannus with Rimefang. Jaina or Sylvanas appear in the story finale.

title: Halls of Reflection
content: Halls of Reflection is the final ICC 5-man wing. Players flee the Lich King through his halls with Falric, Marwyn, and an escape sequence. The Lich King himself appears at the end. Completing the chain unlocks the ICC raid entrance quest.

title: Obsidian Sanctum
content: Obsidian Sanctum is a level 80 raid beneath Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight. Sartharion is the sole boss; keeping drake mini-bosses alive increases difficulty and loot (3-drake zodiac achievements). Drops tier 7 and drake mounts. Entry-level Wrath raid alongside Naxxramas.

title: The Eye of Eternity
content: The Eye of Eternity is a level 80 single-boss raid in Borean Tundra where Malygos, Aspect of the blue dragonflight, is the final boss of the Nexus War. Players fight on floating platforms with drake mounts. Drops tier 7 gear and the Reins of the Azure Drake.

title: Vault of Archavon
content: Vault of Archavon is a level 80 raid inside Wintergrasp Fortress, accessible only when your faction controls Wintergrasp. Archavon, Emalon, Koralon, and Toravon are weekly loot pinatas dropping tier pieces and PvE gear. Popular for casual raid groups.

title: Trial of the Crusader
content: Trial of the Crusader is a level 80 raid at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. The Northrend Beasts, Jaraxxus, Faction Champions, Twin Val'kyr, and Anub'arak form a tournament gauntlet. Heroic ToGC offers top-tier loot before Icecrown Citadel.

title: Icecrown Citadel
content: Icecrown Citadel is the level 80 flagship raid of Wrath where players assault the Lich King's fortress. Twelve bosses include Lord Marrowgar, Deathbringer Saurfang, Festergut and Rotface, Professor Putricide, Blood Queen Lana'thel, Sindragosa, and the Lich King. Normal and heroic 10/25 modes exist. Tier 10 gear and Shadowmourne quest chain drop here.

title: The Ruby Sanctum
content: The Ruby Sanctum is a level 80 raid added in patch 3.3.5 beneath Wyrmrest Temple. Halion the Twilight Destroyer leads twilight dragon invaders in a three-realm fight (physical, twilight, shadow). Serves as ICC filler content with heroic modes and tier 10 loot.

title: Hellfire Ramparts
content: Hellfire Ramparts is a level 60-62 Outland dungeon in Hellfire Peninsula. Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Omor the Unscarred, and Nazan/Vazruden are bosses. One of the first TBC instances players run after entering the Dark Portal.

title: Mana-Tombs
content: Mana-Tombs is a level 64-66 Auchindoun dungeon in Terokkar Forest. Pandemonius, Tavarok, and Nexus-Prince Shaffar are bosses. Ethereal thieves and arakkoa inhabit the tomb. Short and popular for leveling.

title: Karazhan
content: Karazhan is a level 70 10-player raid in Deadwind Pass. Medivh's tower contains opera events, chess, Moroes, Curator, and Prince Malchezaar. Attunement was required in TBC. A beloved classic raid with varied encounters.

title: Black Temple
content: Black Temple is the level 70 capstone raid in Shadowmoon Valley. Illidan Stormrage is the final boss after a long progression through Naj'entus, Supremus, Shade of Akama, Teron Gorefiend, Gurtogg Bloodboil, Reliquary of Souls, Mother Shahraz, and the Illidari Council. Drops tier 6 gear and the Warglaives of Azzinoth.

title: Serpentshrine Cavern
content: Serpentshrine Cavern is a level 70 raid in Zangarmarsh under Coilfang Reservoir. Lady Vashj is the final boss after Hydross, Lurker Below, Leotheras, and Karathress. Tier 5 tokens drop here. Vashj's naga and coilfang forces defend the cavern.

title: Tempest Keep (The Eye)
content: Tempest Keep raid in Netherstorm features Kael'thas Sunstrider and the four advisors (Al'ar, Solarian, Void Reaver, phase 2 council). Drops tier 5 tokens and legendary weapons. Kael'thas is one of TBC's most iconic encounters.

title: Gruul's Lair
content: Gruul's Lair is a level 70 25-player raid in Blade's Edge Mountains. High King Maulgar and Gruul the Dragonkiller are the two bosses. Entry-level TBC raid dropping tier 4 tokens. Gruul's 'growth' mechanic punishes poor positioning.

title: Magtheridon's Lair
content: Magtheridon's Lair is a level 70 25-player raid in Hellfire Peninsula beneath the Citadel. Magtheridon is a single-boss encounter requiring cube teams to interrupt blast nova. Drops tier 4 tokens. Part of early TBC progression.

title: Sunwell Plateau
content: Sunwell Plateau is the level 70 final TBC raid on Quel'Danas isle. Kil'jaeden is the final boss after Kalecgos, Brutallus, Felmyst, and the Twins (Sacrolash and Alythess). Drops tier 6 gear and the Thori'dal bow. Requires Isle of Quel'Danas unlock.

title: Sethekk Halls
content: Sethekk Halls is a level 67-70 Auchindoun dungeon in Terokkar Forest. Talon King Ikiss and Anzu (bird boss) are notable encounters. Anzu drops the Raven Lord mount. Arakkoa culture and Sethekk cult define the dungeon.
